tagline: 宾得数码相机，2016 年发布
description: 宾得于2016年推出的数码相机。快门速度1/8,000 to 30s, Bulb.。感光度ISO equivalent 100-204,800; K-1 II: 100-819,200.。

specs.传感器: 36.4 MP (7,360 x 4,912) full frame (35.9x24.0mm) CMOS sensor, without an anti-aliasing filter.
specs.取景器: Pentaprism with 100% coverage of the field of view. Magnification: 0.70X (with 50mm F1.4 at infinity).
specs.重量: 800g (1.76 lb/28.22 oz) with battery and SD card.
specs.英文简介: Pentax K-1 is the flagship full frame digital SLR by Ricoh Imaging introduced in 2016.
